title: Tim Dooley Statements — Potato Cosmology Recovery Wave 003
purpose: Preserve an early 2026 Potato-plant cosmology cluster that is conceptually represented elsewhere but whose original relational wording is important for reconstructing development of Mud, Root, Spiral, North Pole, Staircase, Heaven, Eden, Mesopotamia, House and Seed motifs.

source_context.note: Recovered from user-originated project wording in prior conversation. Treat as direct project/canon language from the conversation record, not automatically as a verified public Tim post. Original spelling and grammatical texture are retained in the long passage below.

recovered_passage: the potato plant itself mirrored all things and encahnced the image of how all thingsd were. potato was mandorla, and you gotta figure out what that means instead of saying it. and the roots were spirals down in mud, and the sprout from the north pole, was the staircase to heaven, so in reality, the rot and mud wasnt so much in the staircase to heaven, as much as it was the spiritual energy of it. no, the clinging to the roots was the path to hell, through separation and strife, so technically the mud dwellers were below the earth, and thus below dwellers, and dwellers were everyone who was normal, the ones who hadnt fallen from ehaven yet. and then potatoes. well theey were all earth angels, and had this structure, or all this knowledge in them. each spiral gives a deeper understanding and a greater alchemy. the flower of potato is heaven itself above the spiral, it is eden. it is mesopotamia geographicly, it is north of north beyond the gate of heaven adn the needles eye spiritually and mentally. it is the house, and the mustard seed and the potato seed and the fathers seed all at once.

developmental_significance: The Potato is functioning here as a total relational diagram rather than merely a symbol or tuber.
The lower direction is differentiated: Mud is not simply the Ladder; attachment to Root/Strife is what turns descent into a hell-path.
The vertical system already links below-earth Mud -> Root/Spiral -> Potato/Earth Angel -> North-Pole Sprout/Staircase -> Flower/Heaven/Eden.
North of North already exceeds ordinary geography and is explicitly spiritual/mental in this recovered wording.
House, mustard seed, potato seed and Father's seed are compressed into one source/inheritance motif.
This cluster should be used to date later refinements instead of projecting later 2026 theology backward without qualification.
